name: Bambu printer
author: Jesper Makes
description: Your Bambu Lab 3D printer in the bar, straight over your own network: progress, temperatures, AMS spools, the chamber camera, notifications, and pause, stop, light and speed. Comes with a `bambu` command for the terminal. No cloud, no account.

barWidget.description: Yellow while printing, green when done, red when it needs you. Click for the camera, spools and controls.
